relationships.subject: mtDNA
relationships.evidence_quote: mtDNA leakage activates the NLRP3/cGAS-STING pathway

relationships.subject: mitochondrial dysfunction
relationships.evidence_quote: Mitochondrial dysfunction functions as a core pathogenic hub-rather than the sole cause-linking substrate overload, redox imbalance, calcium stress, organelle quality-control failure, inflammatory signalling, and axonal degeneration in diabetic neuropathy.

key_findings: Narrative review: mitochondrial dysfunction is a core hub linking substrate overload, ROS, calcium stress, inflammasome/cGAS-STING and SARM1 signalling to axonal degeneration in diabetic neuropathy
Most mitochondria-targeted interventions have only preclinical support; human validation lacking
